# Outdoor Programs – Properties

![](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/OP-P-Website-
BANNER-10-4-19-1024x325.jpg)

A council’s largest assets are the properties that it owns or leases. The
pages below are meant to aid the council to develop these properties to best
utilize them to serve youth and adults in the BSA. Didn’t find what you need?
Contact a member of the Outdoor Properties team. Click [OP-P-Info-
Sheet-6-7-2021](https://www.scouting.org/wp-content/uploads/2021/06/OP-P-Info-
Sheet-6-7-2021.pdf) for contact information

## Fiix – BSA partner maintenance software

Learn about the BSA partnership with
**[Fiix](https://www.fiixsoftware.com/bsa/) **to manage your maintenance and
work orders of camp. Download the flier
[here](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/Outdoor%20Program/pdf/420-018.pdf)

## Properties Designs

[BSA design Guidelines](https://www.scouting.org/outdoor-
programs/properties/resources/design-guidelines/) – A library of BSA designs
for various buildings/assets

[Camp Showers and Latrine
drawing](https://www.scouting.org/filestore/Outdoor%20Program/pdf/Camp_Showers_Latrines.pdf)
– design drawings example to upgrade your Showers and Latrines

[Hammock Camping](https://www.scouting.org/wp-
content/uploads/2020/03/SKM_C554e20030314490.pdf) – There has been an interest
in “hammock sleeping” at camp. To answer a number of questions we had a
structural engineer design a multi-person hammock stand.  The stand will
support an adults weight, even if all of the hammocks are used by adults.
Stacking hammocks above and below is prohibited. Accordingly, the drawing only
shows one level.   Injuries caused as a result of variations in the design
shown may result in lawsuits for the council.  Sleep peacefully and enjoy!

## Other Resources

[Program Quality Evaluation
Tool](https://filestore.scouting.org/filestore/pdf/PQET-2018.pdf) – A plan to
help your camp improve the overall program delivery
